content.description: This game is a competitive PvP game being developed with the Fun First philosophy, with a feature set comparable to today's most popular non-crypto autobattlers. ZiberBugs is an initiative started due to the extreme lack of gameplay quality in NFT games. It strives to provide great entertainment, made by a team with over 30,000 joint hours in competitive gaming.
